changelog: Reports: the address banner is back on Roofr's report screen, on by default. It shows the full address with the lot or unit number and a Google Maps link that searches that exact lot or unit, so you can check the pin before ordering. A unit turns the bar amber; if the web form names a different unit, a red warning and a second Maps link for the form's unit show up. Settings > "Show address banner on Roofr" still turns it off.
